representation: last real context token h_l,15, (N, 1280) per representation point; NO reshape (native K=1)

cka_headline.role: Chronos-parity analysis (biased linear CKA, the committed Chronos-2 estimator)

cka_companion.role: finite-sample-bias-corrected analysis (unbiased HSIC; the informative estimator for ABSOLUTE similarity at this N and d)

cka_estimator_roles.biased: Chronos-parity analysis (biased linear CKA, the committed Chronos-2 estimator)
cka_estimator_roles.unbiased: finite-sample-bias-corrected analysis (unbiased HSIC; the informative estimator for ABSOLUTE similarity at this N and d)

note: Biased CKA is retained for direct parity with Chronos-2, but its finite-sample baseline is elevated for TimesFM-3 because the representation dimension is large relative to the number of test observations. Unbiased CKA is therefore used as a robustness analysis for absolute interpretability.
cross_model_caveat: Do NOT compare absolute biased-CKA values across Chronos-2 and TimesFM-3: their finite-sample baselines differ (~0.42 at Chronos-2's n=1048/d=768 vs ~0.83 at TimesFM-3's N=262/d=1280), so the same number does not mean the same similarity. Compare patterns within a model, or compare the unbiased estimates.

cka.centering: feature-centred across the N observations (axis=0), per representation
cka.dtype: float64 (probing.cka._as_2d_f64 casts the float32 cache before centering)

biased.name: biased linear CKA (Kornblith et al. 2019, biased HSIC)
biased.role: HEADLINE / PARITY -- byte-for-byte the estimator the committed Chronos-2 CKA uses, so the two models' analyses are identical
biased.caveat: carries an O(1/n) UPWARD bias; at TimesFM-3's N and d=1280 its value for INDEPENDENT representations is ~0.78-0.96, so absolute values are not readable as similarity and are NOT comparable to Chronos-2's

unbiased.name: unbiased HSIC linear CKA (Song et al. 2012)
unbiased.role: REQUIRED COMPANION -- the finite-sample-bias-corrected analysis; the informative estimator for ABSOLUTE similarity at this N and d
unbiased.bounded: NOT bounded; unrelated representations scatter around 0, including slightly negative values -- that is what makes it unbiased, and it is never clipped or repaired

not_used: Gram-space variants with other finite-sample corrections

effective_rank.name: effective rank = exp(spectral entropy)  (Roy & Vetterli 2007)
effective_rank.definition: s = svdvals(X - mean(X, axis=0)); lam = s**2; p = lam / lam.sum(); H = -sum p log p (natural log); effective_rank = exp(H)
effective_rank.normalized_effective_rank: effective_rank / hidden_dim -- an ADDED diagnostic in this driver only; the raw metric is unchanged and is the one comparable to the Chronos-2 records

probe_independent: no probe weights, predictions, targets or native-head outputs enter either measure

null_floor.meaning: biased-linear-CKA value for two INDEPENDENT Gaussian representations of this shape; the true CKA there is 0, so this is the estimator's own upward bias floor at this (n, d). NOT subtracted from the reported matrix

test.role: Chronos-parity analysis (biased linear CKA, the committed Chronos-2 estimator)
